product_metadata.title: HUIANER Fake Grapes 3 Bunches of Simulation Fruit with Artificial Grape Vines Lifelike Grapr Leaves for Wedding Home Indoor Outdoors Party Garden Wall Decoration
features: Various Usage: You can hang artificial grape ivy on the wall, doors, swings, mirrors, and anywhere you like to enjoy with fake leaves vine. Ideal for weddings, festivals, parties, gardens, home decorations, etc
Wide Application: Faux fruit grapes and vines are reusable. It is the best choice for office, home, photography prop, hotel, outdoor display, shopping mall, supermarket, and other occasions

Lifelike Fruit: High degree of simulation grape, with the same appearance as real fruits. Made of plastic. Total 3 strings grape, each string has 22 pieces grapes, grapes strings size: 6 inch, grapes size: 0.63 inch

Size: Package includes 2 pcs artificial grape vines with 3 strings grapes. Total 2 strands, each strand is approximately 7.5 feet /2.3 meters long. Each strand has 36 leaves, each leaf size 3.14 inch*3.34 inch

Warm Tip: Please keep it away from children below 12 years. They are fake fruits that cannot be eaten. Because the artificial plant is made with plastic, so there maybe will have some smell. Please put the plant placed in ventilated place for 1-2 days
